steps_tex: A company's profit margin is normally measured on revenue (see $4.4$).
item.answer_tex: On revenue: profit is $25$% of ₹$2.5$ crore, ₹$0.625$ crore, so costs are ₹$1.875$ crore. If the margin is taken on cost, cost is $2.5 \div 1.25$, ₹$2$ crore. Accept either when the student names the base; a good $4.4$ check.

item.question: 4. 1600 people voted in an election and the winner got 500 votes. What percent of the total votes did the winner get? Can you guess the minimum number of candidates who stood for the election?
steps_tex: Winner's share, then how the other $1100$ votes can split so no one else reaches $500$.
item.answer_tex: $31.25$%. With only two other candidates, one would get at least $550$, more than the winner. Three others can each stay under $500$ (for example $499$, $499$, $102$). So at least $4$ candidates.
